reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 16 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 89 times in 100, by about 15; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee arrive on a six-game slide in Taylor Jenkins' first season, the first year after the Giannis trade, and Tyler Herro (knee contusion) is questionable. New York, the defending champions, have won three straight, and Josh Hart is back doing shooting work after an ankle problem. The mood gap leans toward the Knicks; a team this deep in a slump often plays tight.
